resolved.summary: The gap jump in the ledge zone is too demanding for this early point in the course. The player fell four times over about 24 seconds before making it across.
The objective says 'Reach the beacon' but no beacon or marker is visible in the plaza. The player wandered and circled the area for about 40 seconds before finding the steps that lead onward.
The button that opens the gate is small and easy to miss on its high shelf. The player spent about 29 seconds circling the room and trying the closed gate before spotting it.
The mushroom enemy in the drop zone reaches the player almost the moment they land, giving them no time to see it or react. It killed the player twice in about 18 seconds.
The EXIT sign at the fork points left, but the left branch is a dead end. The player followed the sign, hit the end of the branch, and had to backtrack for about 15 seconds.
The final corridor is a single straight walk of about 40 seconds with nothing to do or look at along the way. The player commented twice that it was still going before finally reaching the flag.
